meta.subject: fix width burst calculation issue in img cdma in large cube width mode

en.summary: This commit fixes large-width image CDMA burst planning by widening width-burst and burst-need arithmetic through the controller, scatter-gather path, and module interfaces.
why_it_counts: It changes only image-CDMA RTL logic and wiring.
The modified signals directly determine how many DMA bursts are requested and when a burst sequence is considered complete.
The commit message explicitly describes a burst-calculation bug in large cube width mode.
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_ctrl.v widens pixel_planar0_width_burst, pixel_planar1_width_burst, and burst_need arithmetic to 14 bits.
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_sg.v widens req_img_p0_burst_cnt and req_img_p1_burst_cnt logic and updates related comparisons and sign-bit tests.
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_img.v removes the old narrow [11:0] and [10:0] interface slicing when wiring width_burst into the SG block.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: An image DMA engine often computes a total number of bursts from fetch width, left padding, right padding, and packing mode, then subtracts bundle-sized chunks as requests are issued. If the total-burst and remaining-burst counters are narrower than the largest supported image width, the high bits are lost. The scheduler then underestimates remaining work, makes wrong end-of-section decisions, and emits too few memory requests for large images.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A large image width or planar fetch size produces a burst count that exceeds the stale narrow width of the width-burst or remaining-burst counters.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Truncate the total-burst and remaining-burst counts by narrowing their arithmetic and inter-module buses.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: truncate burst-count arithmetic and inter-module bus
portability_notes: Map this to the logic that computes total memory bursts for a line or plane and to the counters that decrement as bursts issue.
The most portable injection is to drop high bits on the burst-count bus that crosses from a planning block into a request-generation block.
Keep the lower bits and bundle counters intact so the failure appears only at larger image widths.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the width-dependent arithmetic that computes total bursts needed for a line or plane fetch.
Reduce the width of the total-burst result and of the bus carrying that result into the request scheduler.
Reduce the width of the scheduler's remaining-burst counters and any sign-bit test used to detect underflow or bundle end.
Leave request issue order unchanged so the only functional change is undercounted total work on large widths.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Image CDMA planar width-burst calculation and SG remaining-burst tracking
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix widens width_burst and burst_need outputs in IMG_ctrl, widens p0/p1 burst-count arithmetic and comparisons in IMG_sg, and removes narrow slicing at the IMG wrapper boundary.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the older 11/12-bit width_burst and burst_need widths, narrow req_img_p0_burst_cnt and req_img_p1_burst_cnt back to their older sizes, and reconnect the IMG wrapper using the old truncated slices.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: For large image widths, the DMA engine issues too few bursts or terminates a burst sequence early, causing incomplete image fetches or mis-scheduled memory requests.
evidence_for_injection: The patch changes arithmetic widths in both the planning block and the scatter-gather block, which ties the bug to real burst scheduling.
Underflow and section-end tests are widened together with the counters, showing functional dependence on the missing high bits.
The wrapper previously truncated the cross-module bus, providing a clean source-level reinjection anchor.
notes: This is a reusable large-width undercount bug pattern for DMA request planners.
The highest-value reverse mutation is usually the inter-module burst-count truncation, because it perturbs multiple downstream decisions at once.

zh.summary: 该提交通过扩展控制器、scatter-gather 路径及模块接口中的 width-burst 与 burst-need 算术位宽，修复了大宽度 image CDMA 的 burst 规划错误。
why_it_counts: 它只修改了 image-CDMA 的 RTL 逻辑和连线。
被改动的信号直接决定 DMA 需要发出多少个 burst，以及何时认为一个 burst 序列已经完成。
提交信息明确指出这是 large cube width 模式下的 burst calculation bug。
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_ctrl.v 把 pixel_planar0_width_burst、pixel_planar1_width_burst 以及 burst_need 算术统一扩展到 14 位。
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_sg.v 扩展了 req_img_p0_burst_cnt 和 req_img_p1_burst_cnt 逻辑，并更新了相关比较与符号位判断。
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_img.v 去掉了连接到 SG 模块时旧的 [11:0] 和 [10:0] 窄位宽切片。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 图像 DMA 引擎通常会根据 fetch width、左右 padding 以及打包模式计算一条线或一个 plane 需要的总 burst 数，然后在发请求时按 bundle 大小逐步扣减。如果总 burst 数和剩余 burst 数的位宽小于支持的最大图像宽度，那么高位会被截掉。调度器因此会低估剩余工作量、错误判断 section 结束，并在大图像场景下发出过少的内存请求。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 大图像 DMA burst 计数算术
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 大图像宽度或 planar fetch 尺寸使得所需 burst 数超过旧的 width-burst 或 remaining-burst 窄位宽范围。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 通过缩窄算术与跨模块总线位宽，截断总 burst 数和剩余 burst 数。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: truncate burst-count arithmetic and inter-module bus
portability_notes: 应映射到负责计算一条线或一个 plane 需要多少内存 burst，以及在发请求时递减这些计数的逻辑。
最可移植的注入方式是截断从规划模块送往请求生成模块的 burst-count 总线高位。
保留下位和 bundle 计数逻辑不变，这样故障只会在大图像宽度上出现。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到按宽度计算 line 或 plane 总 burst 数的算术逻辑。
缩小总 burst 结果的位宽，以及把该结果送入请求调度器的跨模块总线位宽。
缩小调度器内部剩余 burst 计数器以及用于检测下溢或 bundle 结束的符号位判断。
保持请求发出顺序不变，使唯一功能变化就是大宽度下总工作量被低估。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Image CDMA planar width-burst 计算与 SG 剩余 burst 跟踪
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 IMG_ctrl 中扩展了 width_burst 和 burst_need 输出，在 IMG_sg 中扩展了 p0/p1 burst 计数算术和比较逻辑，并在 IMG wrapper 中去掉了窄位宽切片。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复旧的 11/12 位 width_burst 与 burst_need 位宽，把 req_img_p0_burst_cnt 和 req_img_p1_burst_cnt 改回旧尺寸，并把 IMG wrapper 重新连回旧的截断切片。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在大图像宽度下，DMA 引擎会发出过少的 burst 或过早结束 burst 序列，导致图像抓取不完整或内存请求调度错误。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁同时扩展了规划模块和 scatter-gather 模块中的算术位宽，说明问题确实影响真实 burst 调度。
下溢和 section-end 判断与计数器一起扩展，表明缺失高位会直接改变功能判断。
wrapper 之前存在跨模块总线截断，这提供了一个非常清晰的源级逆向注入锚点。
notes: 这是很典型、可复用的大宽度 DMA 欠计数故障模式。
通常最有价值的逆向注入点是跨模块 burst-count 截断，因为它会同时扰动多个下游判断。
